title: Safe Crystals
description: Prevents punching obsidian while holding an end crystal (client-side).
body:
# Safe Crystals

Safe Crystals is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that helps prevent accidental obsidian punching while placing end crystals.

The mod blocks obsidian attack actions while you are holding an End Crystal. This helps keep crystal placement smooth and prevents unwanted block-breaking interactions during crystal PvP.

![Safe Crystals Preview](https://i.imgur.com/aDFGgSR.png)

## Features

* Prevents accidental obsidian punching while holding End Crystals
* Helps keep crystal placement smooth and uninterrupted
* Blocks unwanted obsidian breaking animations
* Includes an in-game toggle keybind
* Shows an actionbar message when toggled
* Configurable through Mod Menu
* Client-side only

## How it works

If Safe Crystals is enabled and you are holding an End Crystal, attacking obsidian is blocked.

This helps prevent accidental obsidian punching during fast crystal placement and keeps the placement flow more consistent.

If the mod is disabled, Minecraft behaves normally again.

![Blocked Obsidian Punching](https://i.imgur.com/jpBcxAm.gif)

## Configuration

Safe Crystals can be configured through Mod Menu.

You can configure:

* Whether the mod is enabled
* Whether actionbar messages are shown
* The toggle keybind

![Safe Crystals Config](https://i.imgur.com/D7mC7Wg.png)

## Toggle Keybind

Safe Crystals includes an in-game keybind for quickly enabling or disabling the protection.

By default, the toggle key is:

```text
B
```

When toggled, the mod can show an actionbar message telling you whether Safe Crystals is enabled or disabled.

![Safe Crystals Toggle](https://i.imgur.com/QeODpcS.png)

## Requirements

* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* Cloth Config

## Optional

* Mod Menu, recommended for in-game configuration
